root_cause.text: The `max_register` field in the regmap configuration was set to the total size of the register memory region (65536) instead of the offset of the last valid register (65532), causing regmap read operations (e.g., via debugfs) to attempt accessing addresses beyond the mapped memory region, leading to a segmentation fault.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes `max_register` from `XDMA_REG_SPACE_LEN` (65536) to `XDMA_MAX_REG_OFFSET` defined as `(XDMA_REG_SPACE_LEN - 4)`, and the commit message explicitly states: "The max_register field is assigned the size of the register memory region instead of the offset of the last register." The crash backtrace shows the fault occurring in `regmap_mmio_read32le` during a debugfs read.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add a macro for the maximum valid register offset to prevent out-of-bounds register access.
intent_record.what: Added a new preprocessor macro `XDMA_MAX_REG_OFFSET` defined as `(XDMA_REG_SPACE_LEN - 4)`.
intent_record.how: This macro provides a constant representing the maximum valid register offset (65532), enabling boundary checks when accessing registers, thus preventing access to the last few bytes or out-of-range offsets.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix regmap max_register to use maximum offset instead of register space length to prevent out-of-bounds register accesses.
intent_record.what: Changed the initialization of the `max_register` field in the `xdma_regmap_config` struct from `XDMA_REG_SPACE_LEN` to `XDMA_MAX_REG_OFFSET`.
intent_record.how: This modifies the maximum allowable register address for the regmap, preventing regmap from attempting accesses beyond the last valid register offset, which could cause read/write out-of-bounds errors.

candidates.rationale: Macro defines the register region length as 65536, but this value is used as max_register, causing out-of-bounds access when reading at offset 65536.
This assignment sets max_register to the total region size instead of the last valid offset, directly causing the vulnerability.

vuln_statements.explanation: This assignment sets max_register to the total register space length (65536) instead of the offset of the last valid register (65532), causing regmap read operations to attempt out-of-bounds memory access and leading to a segmentation fault.

This macro defines the register space length as 65536, but when used as max_register it represents the total size rather than the maximum accessible offset, contributing to the out-of-bounds access vulnerability.
